intents.title: Write the shadow ledger plan as a proposed decision record
intents.statement: Add .afwe/memory/decisions/shadow-ledger-plan.md as status proposed, covering the ledger schema, manual-mode lifecycle, record compaction, expected tree E for P1, API surface, migration, failure behaviour and per-phase acceptance criteria.

intents.title: Register the rewind vocabulary
intents.statement: Add terminology records for a dormant check, a rewind receipt and the expected tree, each with a not-to-be-confused-with note, then recompile the ubiquitous language dictionary.

intents.title: Make ready turns first-class in the plan
intents.statement: Record that turn commit ends ready in engineer mode, that rewind detection must cover ready turns, and that promotion to committed is an event plus a projection rewrite rather than a silent status edit.
